setup.text: Toby angles a borrowed crock toward the light, checks it by smell without comment, and sets it back down. He glances at the tally slate where a second row of marks has been added, then looks to the player. "It'll hold some of it."

option_a.text: Toby tucks a small packet into the cloth with the starter. "Bakery weight."

option_b.text: Toby watches the dough settle into even lumps and resets his count. "Portions are easier to track."

option_c.text:
"That'll hold?"

Toby looks at the tally marks and the crock. "Some of it."
